plan.scope: Exploratory paired input diagnostic specified after the true-state world-model report and one RGB integration demo; no new training or policy evaluation
plan.visual_selection: Reuse the already preselected integration model D seed 7; no selection using this diagnostic
plan.actions: All five previously recorded absolute commands per held-out scene, unchanged
plan.commands_source: Privileged state plus preset offsets during original simulation collection, before execution; this diagnostic replays the recorded command values, not a policy choosing actions from RGB
plan.input: Freshly rendered RGB to visual estimator; estimated XY plus recorded absolute command to frozen macro-outcome predictor
checks: all initial RGB hashes match original transition records
no test labels enter RGB inference or macro-prediction
metrics: final XY error from predicted final coordinate versus recorded actual final coordinate
success and lift Brier, accuracy, AUROC
plan.limits: Single visual checkpoint, same fixed-appearance test scenes, five correlated actions per scene; no policy success improvement or independent real-world generalization claim
